translations.web: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
translations.bsb: Please remember that You molded me like clay. Would You now return me to dust?
translations.kjv: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
translations.asv: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast fashioned me as clay; And wilt thou bring me into dust again?
